comments_text: APD analysis reveals that the sequence of this peptide shows 43.5% similarity to Arasin 2. Molecular formula: C220H325N66O44S1; Mol Wt 4627. GRAVY= --1.5; Wimley-White whole-residue hydrophobicity of the peptide: 1.15 kcal/mol. Activity: Active against E. coli ATCC 25922 (MIC 2 uM), P. aeruginosa ATCC 27853 (MIC 4-8 uM), A. baumannii ATCC 19606 (MIC 4 uM), S. aureus ATCC 25923 (MIC 8-16 uM), and B. subtilis ATCC 6051 (MIC 4 uM).
reference_text: Mar Drugs. 2017 Aug 22;15(8). pii: E261. doi: 10.3390/md15080261. PubMed
